statusNote.en: SafetyCulture's product was rebranded to 'Mitti'; safetyculture.com/pricing now redirects (301) to mitti.com/pricing.

limits.en: Up to 10 users, 5 active inspection templates, basic analytics/training/tasks, up to 300 AI credits per seat per month.

keyLimits.en: Up to 10 users, 5 active inspection templates, basic analytics/training/tasks, up to 300 AI credits/seat/month.
Unlimited active and multi-language templates, advanced analytics/training, permissions management, integrations, SSO, automated maintenance, at least 500 AI credits/seat/month.

Everything in Premium plus enterprise user management, enforced login controls, SCIM provisioning, 24/7 priority support, advanced integrations builder, sandbox environment, at least 800 AI credits/seat/month.

cautions.en: Location-based pricing is also available for multi-site operations at a fixed cost per location with unlimited users per site, a different model than per-seat.

capabilities.en: Digital inspection checklists, safety audits and observations for frontline/field operations.
Training modules, task/issue reporting, and advanced analytics dashboards on paid tiers.
Built-in AI credits per seat for AI-assisted features across all plans.

limitations.en: Free plan is capped at 5 active inspection templates and 10 users.
Advanced security features (SSO, SCIM, enforced login controls) require Premium or Enterprise.
